modifications: No changes to the extracted upstream executable or library bytes. launch.py seeds the normal user configuration and supplies the OSC port and separate command-line scratch configuration. isolation.py confines reference filesystem access and external program execution without changing the upstream binary.
configuration: launch.py seeds HOME/.hydrogen/hydrogen.conf once from the product default settings (OSC enabled, autosave off, English interface language, mixer window closed) and execs runtime/usr/bin/hydrogen --nosplash --osc-port PORT in the foreground, with PBP_FILES_DIR as working folder; with arguments it execs runtime/usr/bin/h2cli with those arguments and --config pointing to a copy of the settings in TMPDIR Landlock is required; filesystem rights are limited to those supported by the kernel ABI; the product can write only its instance/exchange directories and execute only its own main executable and dynamic loader. LADSPA_PATH is pinned to an absent read-only installation directory.
